Rhoda Nana Safowa

  • External Relations and Public Engagement Manager

Ms. Rhoda Nana Safowa (ACIM-UK) is the External Relations and Public Engagement Manager for the AIMS Network.
Prior to AIMS, she worked for institutions such as Now Available Africa, Empire Ghana Advertising, Focus Digital, among others. Her portfolio includes working on renowned brands like Nescafe, Nido, Johnnie Walker, Baileys, ATL, and Sky Girls (under the Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation) among others. Her most celebrated achievements include leading a council of agencies to implement award-winning digital, communications, and creative strategies for consumer marketing campaigns, including events for these brands.

Rhoda’s educational background includes a BSc. Degree in Marketing, a CIM-UK certificate, and she is currently pursuing PMI certification. Her diverse roles over the years have honed her skills in Project Management, Operations, Business Development, Stakeholder Partnerships, Events, Brand Management, Media, and Advertising. Recently, on the AIMS Global level, she played a pivotal role in the execution of the PAMO 2023 Opening and Closing ceremonies in Rwanda, coordinated media engagement for the Gender Summit Africa – 2023, led the on-ground AIMS team in successfully executing the NEF Africa Science Week 2023 across 11 African countries, and also served on the steering committee of The Deep Learning Indaba Conference 2023.

She brings her wealth of experience from the marketing and advertising sector to innovatively improve public engagement in the STEM education space, as well as enhancing stakeholder relations which is useful to the growth of the AIMS ecosystem.
